title: Done only when the ledger sees an artifact
description: A Run may only complete a row when an artifact pointer (PR URL plus head SHA) is verified to exist on the git host; "Completed" text alone never advances status.
acceptance: Run with claimed success and no PR leaves the row in verifying with a flagged event
PR pointer is re-fetched and head SHA compared
Test covers an agent that fabricates a PR URL
core_adaptation: Mirrors the SQL rule that a run succeeds only with a kernel-verified run_artifacts row.
